full_prompt_en: A square, high-contrast black-and-white photograph is an extreme close-up of a woman's face, cropped so that one eye, the nose, and the lips occupy nearly the whole frame. Deep black surrounds the visible features and swallows much of the hair and the farther side of the face. At the upper right, one bright eye looks off to the right beneath a sharply dark brow and long lashes. A second eye sits farther left, but its upper area is mostly lost under shadow. A narrow beam of light runs down the bridge and tip of the nose, separating it from a broad gray cheek and the black hollow beside it. The nostril and the small shadow beneath the nose are sharply defined. At the lower center, the lips are slightly parted and carry a muted pale highlight along their textured surface. Their edges taper into deep shade near the corners of the mouth. The left cheek occupies a large soft gray area, its smooth grain making the dark eye and mouth appear more precise. The frame cuts through forehead and chin, removing any clothing, environment, or wider pose. This close crop turns a few familiar facial planes into an arrangement of black shapes, gray gradients, and isolated silver-white ridges. The photographic surface retains fine grain rather than glossy smoothness. Directional side light enters from the upper right, strikes the eye socket, nose ridge, cheek, and lips, and falls quickly into shadow on the opposite side. No background detail or readable text is visible. The overall composition is intimate and severe, using sharply localized light and large areas of darkness to concentrate attention on gaze and facial contour.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、高反差的黑白照片，是一名女子脸部的极近距离特写；画框裁得很紧，一只眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇几乎占满全幅。深黑色包围可见五官，吞没大部分头发和脸的另一侧。右上方，一只明亮的眼睛在浓黑眉毛和长睫毛下望向右侧。另一只眼睛位于较左处，但其上方大部分隐入阴影。一道狭窄的光沿鼻梁和鼻尖向下，把它与宽阔灰色面颊以及旁边的黑色凹处区分开。鼻孔和鼻下的小阴影被清楚界定。下方中央，嘴唇微张，带纹理的表面有低调浅色亮部。唇缘在嘴角附近渐渐沉入深影。左脸颊占据一大片柔灰区域，其平滑颗粒让深色眼部和嘴唇显得更精确。画框切过额头和下巴，没有留下衣服、环境或更完整的姿态。这种紧贴裁切把熟悉的几个面部平面转变为黑色形块、灰阶渐层和孤立银白亮脊的排列。摄影表面保留细微颗粒，而非光滑发亮。定向侧光从右上进入，照到眼眶、鼻梁、面颊和嘴唇，并在另一侧迅速落入阴影。画中没有背景细节或可读文字。整体构图亲密而严峻，以高度局部化的亮光和大片黑暗把注意力集中在目光与面部轮廓上。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome photography isolates a few luminous planes inside a large, nearly black field. Tight cropping removes contextual detail, letting curves, ridges, and soft gray gradients function almost as abstract geometry. Directional side light creates a narrow bright path with rapid falloff, while adjacent shadow absorbs outer edges and produces strong visual weight. Grain remains fine but perceptible in the middle grays; the lightest surfaces show delicate texture rather than a plastic gloss. Sharp focal details alternate with broad smooth tonal areas. The overall effect is intimate, graphic, and austere, with a small concentration of silver light commanding deep negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差单色摄影把少量发亮平面孤立在大片近黑色场里。紧贴裁切移除环境细节，让曲线、凸脊和柔灰渐层几乎成为抽象几何。定向侧光形成狭窄的明亮路径并迅速衰减，邻近阴影吞没外侧边缘，产生很强的视觉重量。中灰区域保留细密而可感的颗粒；最亮表面显出细腻质地，而非塑料般光泽。清楚的焦点细节与宽阔平滑的明度区域交替。整体效果亲密、图形化且严峻，少量集中的银色亮光统领深重负空间。
theme_en: An extreme monochrome close-up of a woman's eye, nose and lips
theme_zh: 女子眼睛、鼻子与嘴唇的极近距离单色特写
name: Ralph Gibson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
